artifacts.rationale: No Mendelian diseases are caused by loss-of-function (LoF) variants across 13 categories. GWAS signals are primarily lipid/metabolic biomarkers, which are likely related to the target scope.

needs.query: Is the gene LoF-intolerant (e.g., pLI > 0.9 or low LOEUF)?

artifacts.rationale: High LOEUF (1.02), pLI near 0, and minimal DepMap dependency indicate that loss of function is well-tolerated in humans and cell lines. Secreted location is favorable for druggability.
